meta.title: Download ai-jail for Linux and macOS
meta.description: Download the latest ai-jail release: prebuilt archives for Linux x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon with SHA-256 checksums, package manager options, and the release notes.

hero.title: Download ai-jail {tag}
hero.lede: Released {date}. One archive for Linux and one for macOS, each with a SHA-256 checksum next to it. Free software under {license}.

builds.title: Binaries
builds.lede: The install is one step: unpack the archive and put ai-jail somewhere on your PATH.

items.title: Linux x86_64
items.text: Needs bubblewrap, the small program ai-jail uses to build the sandbox. Most distributions package it as bubblewrap.

items.title: macOS Apple Silicon
items.text: For Macs with an M series chip. The binary is signed and notarized by Apple, so macOS runs it without a warning.

verify.title: Check the checksum
verify.text: Put the archive and its .sha256 file in the same folder and run the line for your system. It prints OK when the archive matches.
verify.more: Release tags are signed as well. Security lists how a release is made and what is still missing.

windows.title: Windows
windows.text: There is no native Windows build. Use WSL2 and the Linux archive inside it.

channels.title: Package managers
channels.lede: Each of these installs the same program through a tool you already use, and updates come from it.

items.title: Arch Linux
items.text: ai-jail-bin is the prebuilt binary. ai-jail builds from source.

items.title: crates.io
items.text: Builds with Rust {rust} and the dependency versions the release was tested with.

items.title: Nix
items.text: The flake points ai-jail at its own copy of bubblewrap.

changelog.title: Release notes
changelog.lede: The last {n} releases, as the project publishes them.
changelog.english: Release notes are the project's own text and stay in English.

items.title: Install
